bio: This picture-perfect Baden country inn boasts tastefully designed, inviting guestrooms and serves excellent food. The owner's son-in-law runs the kitchen, serving up regional cuisine that showcases seasonal produce – dishes such as braised beef cheeks in a Burgundy sauce or saddle of venison with cranberries and spaetzle are especially popular. Putting the emphasis on flavour and proper seasoning, only the finest and freshest ingredients are used. Charming and professional front-of-house team....
